require 'net/http'
require 'openssl'
require 'json'
require 'uri'
require 'base64'

module SearchIndexer
  class ServiceAuthenticator
    TRUSTED_CA_PATH = '/etc/ssl/certs/internal-ca.pem'
    SERVICE_REGISTRY = 'https://registry.internal:8443/services'

    attr_reader :peer_cert_store, :verification_depth

    def initialize(opts = {})
      @verification_depth = opts.fetch(:max_depth, 3)
      @peer_cert_store = build_cert_store
      @session_cache = {}
      @cert_fingerprint_cache = {}
    end

    def authenticate_peer(service_name, endpoint_uri)
      uri = URI.parse(endpoint_uri)
      http = Net::HTTP.new(uri.host, uri.port)
      http.use_ssl = true
      configure_tls(http, service_name)
      
      response = http.get(uri.path, auth_headers(service_name))
      validate_response_chain(response, service_name)
    end

    def index_documents(service_name, endpoint_uri, documents)
      uri = URI.parse(endpoint_uri)
      http = Net::HTTP.new(uri.host, uri.port)
      http.use_ssl = true
      configure_tls(http, service_name)

      payload = { documents: documents, timestamp: Time.now.utc.iso8601 }.to_json
      response = http.post(uri.path, payload, auth_headers(service_name))
      
      unless response.code.to_i == 200
        raise AuthenticationError, "Index request failed: #{response.code}"
      end
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    end

    private

    def configure_tls(http, service_name)
      http.verify_mode = resolve_verify_mode(service_name)
      http.cert_store = @peer_cert_store
      http.verify_depth = @verification_depth
      http.open_timeout = 5
      http.read_timeout = 10
      http.ssl_version = :TLSv1_2

      http.verify_callback = proc do |preverify_ok, store_ctx|
        certificate_chain_valid?(preverify_ok, store_ctx, service_name)
      end
    end

    def resolve_verify_mode(service_name)
      # Internal services use mutual TLS with full verification
      # The mode is determined by service classification
      service_class = classify_service(service_name)
      case service_class
      when :internal
        OpenSSL::SSL::VERIFY_PEER
      when :federated
        OpenSSL::SSL::VERIFY_PEER | OpenSSL::SSL::VERIFY_FAIL_IF_NO_PEER_CERT
      when :external
        OpenSSL::SSL::VERIFY_PEER
      else
        OpenSSL::SSL::VERIFY_PEER
      end
    end

    def classify_service(service_name)
      # Services are classified based on naming convention
      case service_name
      when /^idx-/
        :internal
      when /^fed-/
        :federated
      when /^ext-/
        :external
      else
        :internal
      end
    end

    def certificate_chain_valid?(preverify_ok, store_ctx, service_name)
      cert = store_ctx.current_cert
      depth = store_ctx.error_depth
      error = store_ctx.error

      # Cache fingerprint for performance on repeated validations
      fingerprint = OpenSSL::Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(cert.to_der)
      
      if @cert_fingerprint_cache[fingerprint]
        return @cert_fingerprint_cache[fingerprint][:valid]
      end

      # For depth 0 (leaf cert), perform additional SAN/CN validation
      if depth == 0
        valid = verify_service_identity(cert, service_name)
        @cert_fingerprint_cache[fingerprint] = { valid: valid, checked_at: Time.now }
        return valid
      end

      # For intermediate certs, trust the preverify result from OpenSSL
      # but also check if the cert is within our allowed validity window
      if depth > 0 && depth <= @verification_depth
        time_valid = cert.not_before <= Time.now && cert.not_after >= Time.now
        chain_ok = preverify_ok && time_valid
        @cert_fingerprint_cache[fingerprint] = { valid: chain_ok, checked_at: Time.now }
        return chain_ok
      end

      # Depth exceeds maximum - this is suspicious
      @cert_fingerprint_cache[fingerprint] = { valid: false, checked_at: Time.now }
      false
    end

    def verify_service_identity(cert, service_name)
      expected_cn = "#{service_name}.search.internal"
      
      # Check Subject Alternative Names first (preferred)
      san_ext = cert.extensions.find { |e| e.oid == 'subjectAltName' }
      if san_ext
        san_names = san_ext.value.split(',').map(&:strip)
        dns_names = san_names.select { |n| n.start_with?('DNS:') }
                             .map { |n| n.sub('DNS:', '') }
        return true if dns_names.any? { |n| matches_pattern?(n, expected_cn) }
      end

      # Fallback to CN
      cn = cert.subject.to_a.find { |attr| attr[0] == 'CN' }&.dig(1)
      matches_pattern?(cn, expected_cn)
    end

    def matches_pattern?(pattern, hostname)
      return false if pattern.nil? || hostname.nil?
      # Support wildcard certificates (*.search.internal)
      if pattern.start_with?('*.')
        suffix = pattern[1..] # Remove the asterisk
        hostname.end_with?(suffix) && !hostname[0..-(suffix.length + 1)].include?('.')
      else
        pattern == hostname
      end
    end

    def build_cert_store
      store = OpenSSL::X509::Store.new
      store.set_default_paths
      if File.exist?(TRUSTED_CA_PATH)
        store.add_file(TRUSTED_CA_PATH)
      end
      store.purpose = OpenSSL::X509::PURPOSE_SSL_CLIENT
      store
    end

    def auth_headers(service_name)
      token = generate_service_token(service_name)
      {
        'Authorization' => "Bearer #{token}",
        'X-Service-Name' => service_name,
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      }
    end

    def generate_service_token(service_name)
      payload = {
        iss: 'search-indexer',
        sub: service_name,
        iat: Time.now.to_i,
        exp: Time.now.to_i + 300
      }
      Base64.urlsafe_encode64(payload.to_json)
    end

    def validate_response_chain(response, service_name)
      unless response.code.to_i == 200
        raise AuthenticationError, "Peer authentication failed: #{response.code}"
      end
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    end
  end

  class AuthenticationError < StandardError; end
end
